description: This file defines a class QuestionGeneratorNodes that orchestrates the retrieval of context, generation, validation, and finalization of medical exam questions in a language model-assisted system. It includes methods for caching questions, extracting medical terms, ensuring question uniqueness, retrieving relevant context chunks from a vector store, generating questions with GPT, validating their accuracy, and finalizing with citations and metadata.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class that manages the process of retrieving context, generating, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions using OpenAI's GPT models in a structured workflow.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes instance, setting up clients, caches, and resources.

methods.name: list _get_cached_questions(self, chapter_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter from cache or storage to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: float _calculate_question_similarity(self, q1: str, q2: str)
methods.description: Computes similarity ratio between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_medical_terms(self, text: str)
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from a text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: tuple[bool,str] _is_question_unique( self, new_question: str, chapter_id: int, threshold: float = 0.55 )
methods.description: Checks whether a question is unique compared to existing questions based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_covered_topics(self, questions: list)
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions to avoid repetition in contexts.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores(self, chunks: list, score: int)
methods.description: Tracks quality scores of chunks based on question generation confidence.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] retrieve_context(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks from a vector store with smart selection avoiding previously used chunks.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_question(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Uses GPT to generate a new question based on retrieved context, images, and prompts, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] validate_accuracy(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates question accuracy and quality through GPT-based checks.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_citations(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finalizes the question with citations, quality metrics, and metadata updates.
